name: Parkhotel Tristacher See
beschreibung: The Parkhotel Tristacher See is located directly on the shore of the lake of the same name near the town of Lienz in Osttirol. The accommodation offers spacious rooms and suites, its own wellness area, and private lake access with a sunbathing lawn. The atmosphere is quiet and rich in tradition, shaped by the Alpine architecture and the surrounding landscape park. The hotel is aimed primarily at those seeking relaxation and couples who appreciate a stay close to nature. In the hotel's own restaurant, seasonal and regional Austrian cuisine is served, complemented by products from its own garden. The direct lakeside location invites activities such as swimming, boating, or hiking in the surrounding mountain landscape.
